page.layout: One page of text, with two portrait medallions at the head of the page (no text in them beyond the captions printed in the roundels, which are part of the engravings); below them, one block of running text in two paragraphs, full width; no margin notes; a printed ornament below the text. Running head at the top centre; page number at the top right.

main_text.p: IOACHAS filius Iehu, regnauit super Israelem in Samaria anno 23. Ioas filij Ochosiæ Regis Iudæ, qui erat annus à mundo condito 3089. ante Christum natum 873. Hic secutus est impietatem Ieroboam filij Nabat, & peccare fecit Israel: quare iratus Dominus tradidit Israelitas in manu Hazael Regis Syriæ, & Ben-adab filij ipsius Hazael. imperauit annos 16. & successit ei Ioas filius eius. Consulito li. 4. Re. ca. 13. item Iosephum li. Antiquitatum 9. cap. 8.

IOAS, filius Ioachas, mortuo patre regnauit super Israelem anno mundi 3105. ante Christum natum 857. Hic impiè egit, nec declinauit ab omnibus peccatis Ieroboam: recuperauit vrbes de manu Ben-adab, filij Hazael, quas iure belli de manu Ioachas patris sui ille abstulerat: & tribus vicibus eum vicit: quinetiam contra Amasiam Regem Iuda pugnauit, quem & cepit, & templum Domini diripuit: reuersus tandem in Samariam, obiit: & sepultus est in Samaria cum regibus Israël. Successit ei filius suus Ieroboam. Vide 4. lib. Reg. 13. & 14. cap. item Ioseph. lib. Antiq. 9. cap. 10. imperauit hic Ioas annos sedecim. fuit & alter Ioas filius Ochosiæ & Athaliæ, de quo à me dictum est supra, pagina ab hinc tertia.

page.notes: Two engraved medallions at the head of the page, captioned "R. ISRAEL. IEHOIACHAS" (left) and "R. ISRAEL IOAS" (right); they are illustrations, not text, and are not transcribed as text. Printed ornament (fleuron) below the text, not transcribed. Some ink in the text is faint; "Israel" in the first paragraph is read as "Israël" with a diaeresis as printed. Letters "Ioachas" and "Ioas" in the second paragraph are as printed.
